create_ExpertBackupClient: create an ExpertBackupClient instance with server args and model runner to initialize ZMQ sockets for expert weight backup
run_update_weights: run the update_weights method to transfer expert weights from remote backup via Mooncake transfer engine
run_start_transfer_client: run start_transfer_client to register local GPU memory buffers with the Mooncake transfer engine
run_extract_layer_and_expert_id: run extract_layer_and_expert_id to parse a PyTorch parameter name and extract layer ID, expert ID, and weight name
run_receive_loop: run the receive_loop background thread to collect weight pointer maps and session IDs from all engines
